profile.headline: Privacy Engineer | Governance | Risk | Compliance
profile.summary:
I am a team-oriented and driven Software Engineer with a strong foundation in developing client solutions and a demonstrated passion for continuous learning. My background includes leveraging Regulatory Compliance Management to create AI-driven governance, risk, and compliance solutions. I am passionate about applying analytical problem-solving skills to achieve operational excellence and foster innovation. As a data-driven professional, I am skilled at delivering results focused on enhancing revenue, brand value, creativity, and customer satisfaction.   

My technical expertise encompasses a wide range of technologies, including Python, CI/CD, MLOps, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and various IBM Cloud technologies. I have experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, optimizing AI solutions, and designing automated workflows. I am adept at assessing client needs and providing effective technical solutions, focusing on enhancing customer business through innovative applications.

positions.title: Privacy Software Developer
positions.description:
Leveraged Regulatory Compliance Management to break down complex regulations and create AI-driven, highly scalable governance, risk, and compliance solutions
Key Accomplishments:
   -	Implemented continuous integration, and continuous delivery of MLOps pipeline solutions for the Cognitive Enterprise Data Platform
   -	Actively suggested and implemented process optimizations for Watson OpenScale, and created test metric parameters within OpenScale to run custom metadata for client use cases
   -	Designed and developed automated workflows within IBM OpenPages, streamlining operational risk management, policy compliance, financial oversight, and audits

positions.title: Technical Solutions Specialist
positions.description:
Assessed client technical needs, and provided technical solutions to enhance customer business using IBM-centered products
Key Accomplishments:
   -	Created a genericized POC demo of iOS and Web App solutions to be used for clients
   -	Solved complex technical problems by educating stakeholders on the value of IBM products for mobile and web applications

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Languages: 
•	HTML, Vue, React, Javascript, MySQL, Node.JS, jQuery, CSS, Express, AJAX, Firebase, Bootstrap

Applications: 
•	GIT, GitHub, MySQL, Postman, Heroku

positions.title: Accounts Payable Specialist
positions.description:
Analyzed, coded, and entered vendor invoices on a timely basis, paying attention to service periods and corresponding with other departments for proper general ledger reporting
Key Accomplishments:
   -	Program Administrator for company-wide Amex program; responsible for processing new cardholders and completing month-end reconciliations of the Amex account in the general ledger

positions.title: Accounts Payable Specialist
positions.description:
Resolved invoice exceptions to process invoices timely by performing in-depth 3-way match analysis. Mitigated client requests/queries in a timely fashion – continually seeking out ways to improve client satisfaction
Key Accomplishments:
   -	Responsible for monthly accruals and ensuring expenses are accurately recorded

positions.title: Accounts Payable Team Lead
positions.description:
Achieved accounting operational objectives by capturing all Accounts Payable transactions via Oracle, completing audits, identifying trends and providing recommendations for system improvements
Key Accomplishments:
   -	Met accounting financial objectives by completing daily, monthly, and quarterly reports, scheduling expenditures, analyzing variances, and initiating corrective actions
